organizations.name: U.S. Dept. of Education — Office for Civil Rights
organizations.eligibility: Students/parents at any school receiving federal funds (180-day deadline)
organizations.what_they_help_with: Federal complaints about race, sex, and disability discrimination in schools — discipline disparities, harassment, denied services. Free; no lawyer needed.

organizations.name: Education Law Center
organizations.eligibility: Students and parents, focus on under-resourced districts
organizations.what_they_help_with: Students' educational rights — school funding equity, special education, discipline. Guides and legal advocacy.

organizations.name: UNCF (United Negro College Fund)
organizations.eligibility: Black students pursuing college; scholarship criteria vary
organizations.what_they_help_with: Scholarships, HBCU pathways, and college-access programs — routes to college that remain fully legal post-SFFA.

organizations.name: Learning for Justice (SPLC)
organizations.what_they_help_with: Free inclusive-curriculum materials and guidance for educators and parents responding to curriculum censorship.
